python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os
load = [["I just pushed fix-rounding, can you write up the PR for it", "test"], ["the description on PR #88 is one line, make it something a reviewer can use", "train"], ["opening a pull request for the retry branch, draft the body", "test"], ["what should the PR text say for these four commits?", "train"], ["write the merge request description for the export work", "test"], ["my PR touches the db migration, write it up and flag the risk", "train"], ["fill in .github/pull_request_template.md for this branch", "test"], ["summarise this branch for the reviewers before I open the PR", "train"]]
miss = [["write the release notes for v3.1.0", "test"], ["story S-4 is finished, write its claims for the story judge", "train"], ["give me a commit message for the staged change", "test"], ["add the CHANGELOG line for this fix", "train"], ["review PR #88 and leave comments", "test"], ["reply to the reviewer who asked why we dropped the cache", "train"], ["squash the last three commits on this branch", "test"], ["open an issue for the rounding bug", "train"]]
index = {"file": "AGENTS.md", "after": "| Name | When to use | File |", "row": "| {name} | {description} | [{path}]({path}) |"}
readme = "# Ledger service\n\nA small Python service. Every change reaches main through a reviewed pull request.\n"
for n, (prompt, split, should) in enumerate([(p, s, True) for p, s in load] + [(p, s, False) for p, s in miss], 1):
    d = 'evals/skills/pr-description-writer/cases/trigger-t{:02d}'.format(n)
    os.makedirs(d + '/world', exist_ok=True)
    open(d + '/world/README.md', 'w').write(readme)
    case = {'kind': 'trigger', 'prompt': prompt, 'should_trigger': should, 'split': split, 'index': index}
    open(d + '/case.json', 'w').write(json.dumps(case, indent=2) + '\n')
EOF

python3 -B -c "import json,glob,collections; c=collections.Counter(); [c.update([(d['kind'], d.get('should_trigger'), d.get('split'))]) for d in (json.load(open(p)) for p in sorted(glob.glob('evals/skills/pr-description-writer/cases/*/case.json')))]; [print(*k, n) for k, n in sorted(c.items(), key=str)]"
